t: What he said walking alone at night
a: إِنَّ الْمُكْثِرِينَ هُمُ الْمُقِلُّونَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ، إِلاَّ مَنْ أَعْطَاهُ اللَّهُ خَيْرًا
p: Inna-l-mukthirīna humu-l-muqillūna yawma-l-qiyāmah, illā man aʿṭāhu-Llāhu khayran
m: Those who have the most will be those who have the least on the Day of Resurrection, except for the one Allah gave good to,
